The stale roster hallucination primitive ensures that only valid players appear in emits, preventing spurious prop generation. The two-high defensive shell primitive introduces a stochastic suppression mechanism where intermediate volume increases but extreme values are bounded—this is modeled via a Gumbel extreme-value distribution.
